whyMe.headline: Why me
whyMe.text: I am retraining as a software developer at the Developer Akademie, learning to build modern web apps from frontend to backend. What excites me most is turning an idea into something people actually use. I enjoy solving tricky problems step by step and learning every day.

skills.headline: My Skills
skills.challengeText: I am always happy to learn new technologies. Just tell me what you need.

projects.headline: My Projects
projects.join: Task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create and organize tasks with drag and drop and assign them to contacts.
projects.elPolloLoco: 2D jump and run game with JavaScript and the Canvas API. Help Pepe collect coins and salsa bottles to defeat the giant hen.
projects.pokedex: Pokédex with data from the PokéAPI. Search for Pokémon, load more and view their info, stats and evolutions.

privacyPolicy.headline: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.generalText: This privacy policy explains which personal data is processed when you visit this website, for what purpose, and which rights you have. Personal data is any data that can be used to identify you personally.
privacyPolicy.hostingText:
This website is hosted by an external hosting provider. Each time you visit it, the server automatically stores information that your browser transmits (server log files). This includes your IP address, the date and time of access, the requested page, the previously visited page (referrer) as well as the browser and operating system you use.

This data is necessary to provide the website securely and reliably. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. My legitimate interest is a secure and error-free presentation of the website. The data is not combined with other data sources.
privacyPolicy.sslText: For security reasons, this website uses SSL or TLS encryption. You can recognize an encrypted connection by the address bar of your browser starting with “https://” and showing a lock symbol.
privacyPolicy.contactFormText:
If you send me a message via the contact form, I process your name, your email address and your message in order to answer your request. The data is sent to me by email and is not passed on to third parties.

The legal basis is your consent according to Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR, which you give via the checkbox in the form. You can withdraw it at any time by sending me an email. This does not affect the lawfulness of the processing carried out until then. I delete your data as soon as your request has been dealt with and there are no legal retention obligations.
privacyPolicy.storageText: So that the website shows your chosen language again on your next visit, it is saved in the local storage of your browser. This information is not transmitted to me and is only used to display the website the way you set it up (Section 25 (2) No. 2 TDDDG). You can delete the entry at any time in your browser settings. This website does not use cookies.
privacyPolicy.fontsText: The fonts on this website are hosted locally. No connection to servers of Google or other providers is established when you visit the page.
privacyPolicy.linksText: This website contains links to external websites, for example to GitHub and to my projects. You are only redirected to the respective page when you click a link. The respective provider is responsible for the data processing there.
privacyPolicy.rightsText: You have the right to access your stored data (Art. 15 GDPR), to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR), to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR), to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR), to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR) and to object to the processing (Art. 21 GDPR). You can withdraw any consent you have given at any time (Art. 7 (3) GDPR). Just send me an email.
privacyPolicy.complaintText:
You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR). The authority responsible for me is the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information of North Rhine-Westphalia.

Date: September 30, 2026
